findings.evidence: Carrier sets stopped on any category:not-run at544 and then requires every later row to be not-run; it forbids all not-run exchanges at552–555. Real runner prerequisiteResultBeforeRun2986–3022 emits an individual harness-error/not-run with prerequisiteFailure.phase:initial; mustStopMatrixAfter448–468 returns false for ordinary not-run. prerequisiteFailureResult3027–3055 emits not-run with retained recheck exchanges and phase:recheck (may continue if no stop category). Current RU baseline has7 actual prerequisite actions, so this is reachable in the frozen owner set.
findings.impact: Genuine failed/partial RU reports are refused or lose the ability to retain an actual prerequisite recheck transcript. A dependent skip does not imply that every following independent/diagnostic row was stopped.
findings.requiredCorrection: Use the real runner prerequisite/stop distinctions: validate known prerequisite ID/phase/category against the fixed manifest/catalog, allow legitimate retained recheck exchanges with no authored execution credit, and do not infer global stop from every not-run row. Preserve actual true-abort stopped suffix, exact full IDs/order/index and null credit. Add finite source-data subcontrols within existing L08/R22 (no new runner/product execution or callback).
